artworks.title: Self-Portrait in a Velvet Cap with Plume
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man, depicted from the waist up, seated and facing forward. He has a beard, curly, shoulder-length hair under a hat, and is wearing a fur-lined cloak over an elaborately embroidered garment with intricate details on the sleeves and front. He wears a soft, feathered hat with a wide brim. In his left hand, he holds what appears to be a cane or staff. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Sheet with Two Studies:  a Tree, and the Upper Part of a Head of the Artist Wearing a Velvet Cap
artworks.dimensions: sheet (sheet trimmed to platemark): 8 × 7.1 cm (3 1/8 × 2 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays intricate, swirling lines and textured shading to create an abstract scene. On the left side are fine lines resembling branches and leaves, with a small figure nearby. On the right side is a large, densely shaded form reminiscent of mountains or a rock formation. The elements come together to suggest landscapes and nature through imaginative shapes and line work.

artworks.title: Bust of an African Woman
artworks.description: The image displays a bust-length etching of a person in profile view. The individual is depicted seated, facing slightly right. The artwork details facial features like full lips, a prominent forehead, and eyes that are partially hidden. The person's hair is styled back with some falling behind, potentially secured with a braided or band-like accessory. They wear a garment with fabric folds and possible decorative elements at the neckline. The background is minimally detailed with shading or textural lines, emphasizing the subject.

artworks.title: Reclining Female Nude
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on Japan paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.3 x 16 cm (3 1/4 x 6 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a nude figure lying down, seen from the back with most of the body visible. The figure is positioned horizontally on a surface that resembles a bed or couch, with the head turned away. The hair is either closely cropped or not clearly defined due to shading. The artist used dense cross-hatching and shading to depict depth and contour, highlighting the figure's curves and musculature. The image does not show any facial features. The background is filled with dark cross-hatching, creating a dimly lit space with lighter areas suggesting fabric beneath the figure. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects. The overall composition is moody and textured, emphasizing light and shadow.

artworks.title: Reclining Female Nude
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an abstract form resembling a reclining figure. The composition uses hatched and cross-hatched lines to create the form lying upon a draped cloth or sheet. The texture is rich, with shadows to provide a sense of volume and depth. The background is dark, making the lighter areas of the form stand out in contrast. The focus is on the contours and the play of light across the shape, creating an evocative atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Goldsmith
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a workshop scene showing a sculpture and tools. The image features a craftsman carving a sculpture of a human form on a pedestal. In the background, there is a detailed fireplace or furnace. The drawing showcases precise line work and cross-hatching techniques to create texture and depth. Various tools are placed around the craftsman, indicating attention to detail and craft complexity. The image depicts a moment of concentration between an artisan and their craft.

artworks.title: The Image Seen by Nebuchadnezzar
artworks.dimensions:
image: 10 × 7 cm (3 15/16 × 2 3/4 in.)
sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 10.6 × 7 cm (4 3/16 × 2 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical statue. The image depicts an etched figure resembling a classical statue of a man adorned with cloth drapery. It stands on a pedestal marked with inscriptions like "Baboe," "Nabuc," "Grec," "Romani," and "Hetman." The background is shaded intensely to highlight the figure, a common technique in etchings, where the cross-hatching style adds depth. The artwork is signed with "Rembrandt" in the corner.

artworks.title: Jacob's Ladder
artworks.dimensions:
image: 10.6 × 7 cm (4 3/16 × 2 3/4 in.)
sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.5 × 7.5 cm (4 1/2 × 2 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an etching with multiple figures. In the foreground, a person is reclined, partly covered in drapery, eyes closed. Above, another person is sitting, facing forward. On the right, a larger figure with wings is seen from the back, raising one arm. The image uses light and shadow effectively, with a dark background of more draped figures. There is a signature at the bottom left that reads "Rembrandt f. 1654."

artworks.title: Jacob's Ladder
artworks.dimensions:
image: 10.6 × 7 cm (4 3/16 × 2 3/4 in.)
sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.4 × 7.7 cm (4 1/2 × 3 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of multiple figures with varying visibility of their bodies. In the foreground is a reclined figure partially draped in cloth, with their head resting to one side. Above this figure, on the left side, there is an angelic figure with wings kneeling and leaning forward. Another figure is higher up on the right, turned away from the viewer and reaching upwards, showing the entire back and wings. The background features dark crosshatching and suggestive lines indicating light filtering through an unseen barrier, enhancing the dramatic lighting and shadowing in the composition.

artworks.title: Jacob's Ladder
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting multiple figures arranged in a diagonal pattern. The figures are shown in various poses, including standing, kneeling, and lying down. The facial features are indistinct, with emphasis on shading and texture. The hair and garments flow naturally, suggesting traditional historical clothing. Some figures appear to have wings. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by the figures. The background is filled with heavy cross-hatching and shadowing. The scene is richly textured and atmospheric, with dark tones dominating the palette.

artworks.title: Christ Returning from the Temple with His Parents
artworks.description: The image features three figures standing in a landscape setting. On the left, a woman is slightly bending forward, holding the hand of a young boy in the center. She is wearing a headscarf and a long robe. The young boy looks towards the man on his other side. The man on the right is wearing a brimmed hat and a long coat, holding a walking stick. A small dog is at their feet. The background shows hills and rock formations.

artworks.title: Christ Seated Disputing with the Doctors
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people gathered together in an enclosed space. The central figure is seated and looking towards a young child standing next to them. The individuals have various facial features, with some having beards and different head coverings. Their facial expressions indicate interaction, but specific details are unclear. They are dressed in loose, long-sleeved garments, with some wearing hats or wraps on their heads. The scene is depicted in a sketch-like style with detailed linework showing their clothing folds and positions. The background features textured walls, and there are no other distinct elements to identify the setting.

artworks.title: The Circumcision in the Stable
artworks.description: This image features a close-up scene set within a dimly lit interior space. The composition is centered around a group of people, focusing on an adult holding a small infant. Surrounding them are several figures, including a woman wearing a headscarf, and another adult close to the infant. The individuals' facial features are detailed, although obscured by shadows. Clothing is depicted with textured lines, indicating various garments. To the left, a person is shown positioned above the others, wearing a hood or hat. In the background, there is a ladder and what appears to be a tapestry. The shading technique adds to the visualization of this scene.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds: with the Lamp
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic scene. The drawing shows an interior setting resembling a rustic, stable-like structure. The focus is on a central figure, a newborn, lying in a manger or cradle, surrounded by admirers. The scene includes multiple figures standing or kneeling, with expressions and postures conveying reverence and tenderness. There are human figures and animals such as cows in the background. The use of hatching and shading adds depth and texture to the setting, capturing a moment of intimate observation within a humble environment.

artworks.title: The Golf Player
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated inside a room. He is reclining against a table with his legs stretched out in front of him. His facial features are obscured by shadows, as his head is turned slightly downwards. He is wearing a wide-brimmed hat that casts further shadow and his hair is slightly wavy, touching his shoulders. The man is dressed in a buttoned shirt with a collar and pants that expose his lower legs. There is another figure to the left of the image, seemingly a man in motion with a stick, wearing similar attire including a hat. In the background, there are sketches of two more figures drawn with minimal details. The scene appears to be indoors, characterized by cross-hatched shading suggesting walls and a window frame. A small cup or object is on the table near the seated man.

artworks.title: Peasant Family on the Tramp
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures standing next to each other. In the center, there is an adult holding a walking stick and wearing a tall hat. Next to them, a child is holding the adult's hand. Behind them is another adult, possibly a female, with a head covering.

artworks.title: David in Prayer
artworks.description: The image displays the upper body of a person kneeling next to a bed with their hands clasped together. Their head is slightly tilted upward, and their face is in profile. The person is covered in a long garment, surrounded by a sumptuous bed with elaborate curtains and a piece of furniture at the foot of the bed. The setting indicates a richly furnished interior with heavy fabric and detailed etching, suggesting an intimate and enclosed space.

artworks.title: The Star of the Kings: a Night Piece
artworks.medium: etching, with a few touches of drypoint
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 9.8 x 14.7 cm (3 7/8 x 5 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a candlelit scene in a dark interior with a prominent star. The image is composed of intricate line work and shading, depicting a group gathered closely around a table, illuminated by a single bright light source which appears to be a star or candle. The use of contrast between the dark background and the light foreground emphasizes the centered illumination. This is in the style of Rembrandt, characterized by the play of light and shadow and the texture achieved through etching techniques. The figure arrangements and their interplay with the light contribute to the mysterious and contemplative mood of the scene.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt: a Night Piece
artworks.medium: etching, burin and drypoint on yellowish paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in an outdoor setting. One person is walking beside a donkey while holding a lantern, lighting the path ahead. The person has a beard and is wearing headwear and a long robe. The second person is sitting on the donkey, covered in layers of cloth. The donkey is carrying loads on each side. The background is dark, emphasizing the illuminated circle from the lantern.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt: a Night Piece
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dimly lit scene with multiple elements partially obscured by shadow. The drawing is composed mainly of dark tones, with a central area that seems to be illuminated, depicting a figure holding a lantern. The glow from the lantern casts light on surrounding details, creating a contrasted effect against the dark backdrop. The textures in the drawing seem meticulously rendered, with cross-hatching and shading adding depth and intricacy to the scene. Other forms appear around the central figure, though they are less distinctly outlined and seem enshrouded in the darkness which dominates the composition. The overall atmosphere is one of mystery and moodiness, inviting viewers to look more closely to discern the subtle details.

artworks.title: The Bathers
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a group of figures interacting in a natural landscape. The composition includes various figures engaged in different activities within a wooded setting. In the foreground, one figure is sitting while another is crouching and reaching towards something. A figure stands amidst the trees in the middle ground, adding depth to the scene. To the right, more figures are bending over, potentially interacting with the water or the earth. The landscape features intricate line work illustrating lush foliage and gentle slopes, creating a tranquil and lively natural scene. The attention to detail and the placement of elements showcase a harmonious balance between the figures and their environment.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Square Tower
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a ruined tower in the middle, surrounded by thatched cottages and rolling hills with trees. The scene is depicted in black and white with detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Cow
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with structures and natural surroundings. The horizon is in the center, with hills and fields in the distance. Below the horizon are outlines of more landscape details. The artwork uses fine etching lines for texture, emphasizing buildings and trees. The color palette is sepia and gray. Closest to us is a body of water reflecting surrounding textures, leading to buildings and trees on the left. The background fades into the distance with less detail.

artworks.title: Canal with a Large Boat and Bridge
artworks.description: The image depicts a wooden boat on the edge of a river or canal, pointing towards the water. Across the water, a landscape with trees, a tower, and an obelisk is visible under an overcast sky. The etching features fine lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth, typical of Rembrandt's style. The color scheme is monochromatic, with dark ink on light tan paper. Trees on the right frame the scene, enhancing the portrayal of nature.
